title: view_outbox item (SummaryViewOutbox)
description: Outbox of summary views, written when the detail is served; its Stream publishes SummaryViewed.v1 (EV-28, ADR-019, RF-048).
$comment: Table view_outbox (per cell). Partition key only: PK = VIEW#<eventId>. AP-G3: conditional PutItem by eventId. Streams -> relay of SummaryViewed.v1. TTL attribute ttl = TTL_outbox (DEC-28); the relay does not rewrite the item, so state stays PENDING.

eventId.description: eventId generated when serving the detail.

ttl.description: Epoch seconds; DynamoDB TTL = createdAt + TTL_outbox (DEC-28).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: Constant PENDING: the Stream publishes the item; it expires with TTL_outbox. Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
